{{Top|leg}}
A '''lift disk''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] platform. Located on the surface of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], they could be used to access floating facilities. The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ree Shala]] used a lift disk to provide access to her [[Ree Shala's base|hovering base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Jaresh/Legends|Jaresh]].
